## FX Audit — Quickstart

Here are three common ways to plug iPayX into your product.

### FX broker / multi-currency platform

Send each client FX conversion (CAD→USD, EUR→CAD, etc.) to the iPayX API and return a 0–10 FX score with estimated hidden costs.

### Corporate treasury

Feed your international payments (supplier invoices) into iPayX to compare bank rates vs mid-market and track margin impact.

### Accounting firm / fractional CFO

Use the API to audit your clients' FX conversions at year-end and generate a standardized report with score and potential savings.

Connect your data

## Three ways to send your transactions

Pick the source that fits your stack. All converge into the same FX audit engine.

PlaidAvailableUS & Canada

Read-only bank connectivity. Automatic FX transaction extraction from North American accounts.

CSV / PDF uploadAvailableGlobal

Import statements or receipts. Built-in OCR normalizes transactions automatically.

REST APIAvailableGlobal

Send transactions directly via the API. Ideal for ERP, treasury, and platform integrations.

### Universal bank coverage — anywhere Plaid does not reach

Plaid covers US and CA institutions. For any other region — or when a connection fails — iPayX accepts **any bank statement in PDF or CSV, worldwide** — no degraded experience for your prospects.

  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{

    {
      "id": "tx_001",

      "source_amount": 1000000,
      "target_amount": 1018900,

## Authentication

Authenticate every request using your production API key in the Authorization header.

`Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_your_key`

Generate and manage your key in the Dashboard. Keys are server-side credentials and must never be exposed in client-side code.

## Your Competitive Rate — Partner Configuration

[Log in to configure your competitive rate →](https://www.ipayx.ai/auth)

HOW PARTNER SCORING WORKS

When your API key makes an audit call, iPayX scores the client's bank rate AND your competitive rate — separately.

Example:

  Client bank spread   → 1.89% above mid → FX Score 1/10

  OFX configured rate  → 0.80% above mid → FX Score 5/10  (+4 improvement)

  Airwallex configured → 0.50% above mid → FX Score 7/10  (+6 improvement)

The client sees two scores. You don't fight the bank. You show the math. The client decides.
